name: Final Nerve Obby
desc:
Are you ready for Final Nerve Obby? An electrifying obby adventure with a whopping 180 total stages of ascending difficulty! Can you rise above the challenge and emerge as the undisputed Obby Master? Not even 1% will complete this, Good luck..

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
